target: goal versus non-goal, penalty shootouts excluded
features: position-derived geometry only, no provider xG or post-shot fields
model: L2 logistic regression with standardized geometric basis
selection: minimum validation log loss; no refit on validation
test: one report after selection, plus training-goal-rate reference and paired match bootstrap
transfer: SkillCorner actual pitch length, attack-normalized possession-end coordinates
epv_initial_runs: GNN and ball-only MLP, seed 0, 30 epochs maximum, validation stopping; no EPV test evaluation
